content: Melvin-Koushki proposes that Ibn Turka, Sharaf al-Dīn and their circle in western Iran form the eastern arm of a Neo-Ikhwān al-Ṣafāʾ extra-establishment network (being studied by Fleischer and Fazlıoğlu) centred in Cairo on Akhlāṭī and reaching Ottoman lands through Bedreddīn, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Bisṭāmī and Mullā Fanārī; the network 'appears to have been' so centred.
